_environmentVariables.GCS_ADMIN_TOTP_SECRET: SET_ON_SERVER_ONLY - mandatory: without it /admin sign-in is refused
_environmentVariables.GCS_DIAG_TOKEN: SET_ON_SERVER_ONLY - 16+ chars; send as X-GCS-Diag-Token header for /health/configuration and /health details
_environmentVariables.GCS_RTDN_TOKEN: SET_ON_SERVER_ONLY - 16+ chars; X-GCS-RTDN-Token header, or Pub/Sub push URL /api/store/google/rtdn?token=...
_environmentVariables.GCS_GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS: comma-separated public OAuth client ids (Android and iOS) - not secrets; empty = Google sign-in refused
_environmentVariables.GCS_APPLE_CLIENT_IDS: com.gcar360.app - the app bundle id; empty = Apple sign-in refused
_environmentVariables.GCS_APPLE_ROOT_CA_SHA256: optional - overrides the pinned Apple Root CA G3 fingerprint
